card.summary: S3-compatible storage, slider up to 50 TB on the page; priced at '$100/month ($0.02/GB)' i.e. $20/TB.

free_tier.stated: S3-compatible storage, slider up to 50 TB on the page; priced at '$100/month ($0.02/GB)' i.e. $20/TB.

egress.terms: 'Egress traffic* $0.09/GB — *Charges only apply to traffic outside of our CDN.' So delivery through CDN77's own CDN is free; only pulling straight from storage costs. Initial 50 GB egress free, initial 1M requests free.

record.tooling: S3 API; 'Seamless integration with CDN77 delivery platform'. Growth plan is $990/mo for 250 TB traffic with $3.96/TB overage.
record.chaining: Origin storage integrates with CDN77 without separate origin egress charges. Storage at rest is priced at $20 per TB monthly.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap: none published. Storage at $0.03/10k requests after 1M free. Request pricing exists, unlike Bunny/CacheFly.
record.reliability_note: 330 Tbps, enterprise-oriented; sales-gated plans ('Talk to sales') rather than self-serve checkout. Also one of the few CDNs that explicitly sponsors OSS (Blender, GNOME, Let's Encrypt, Fedora, Manjaro). See the Fast Forward note.

evidence.proved: 'CDN77 Object Storage … S3-compatible API … No egress fees between the storage and CDN77 delivery platform', 'Egress traffic* $0.09/GB', '$100/month ($0.02/GB)', Growth plan '$990/month $3.96/TB overages'

record.price_per_tb_month: $20/TB stored; $90/TB egress outside CDN77; $0 egress through CDN77. Growth plan $990/mo for 250 TB delivered (= $3.96/TB).
